## TEMPORARY_COPY_TTL_MS variable

How long a temporary copy may remain after the caller stops using it: 60 minutes from registration.

**Signature:**

```typescript
TEMPORARY_COPY_TTL_MS: number
```

## Remarks

The caller owns a temporary copy and should release it when done. This bound only removes leftovers. It is longer than the other lifetimes because a local caller reads the copy directly and may hold it while it works.
